# The parcel model in one place {#sec-ch01b}

Every solver of kintera works on the same object: a parcel, a list of amounts of gases and condensates together
with two thermodynamic variables. Chapters 3 to 6 each derive one solver. This chapter says, in one place, which
two variables each solver holds fixed, which conservation laws each step obeys, and which functions the solvers
share. Sharing them is what makes the library self-consistent: the equilibrium found by the phase solver is the fixed
point of the evaporation kinetics, and the latent heat released in a kinetic step is the one the energy solver
uses. The sign convention used throughout is that of the code. `stoich[i][r]` is positive for the products of
reaction $r$ and negative for its reactants, and a vector of reaction extents $\xi$ changes the amounts by
$S\xi$.

| @sec-ch01b-state | the variables each solver holds fixed and the conservation laws of its step | `src/thermo/`, `src/kinetics/` |
| @sec-ch01b-shared | the one saturation function and the one energy model all modules share | `src/thermo/log_svp.cpp`, `src/thermo/eval_uhs.cpp` |
